title: Shinonome Akito — Burnout〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
Then, we know what we're gonna do for practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! I can't wait to try those new exercises!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, it feels like it's been forever since we last came up with a plan for practice like this. But I guess that's because my dad took care of all that for a while, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True, but he did help expand our options in terms of practice quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, the onus is on us to come up with the best ways for us to reach our goal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right! Anyway, now that we know what we're gonna do during practice tomorrow, why don't we take a break?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I was actually just thinking about ordering a refill.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, I might order some food...

Oh...
Are you guys done with your discussion?
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we just finished and were thinking about ordering some stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Really?! Your timing couldn't have been better. I actually have a small favor to ask you, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, so...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I wanna have you taste-test a new menu item! They're pancakes made using strawberries... You game?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You want me to taste-test pancakes...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't had pancakes here at Weekend Garage since before the place closed...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that case, I don't mind lending you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Thanks, I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I thought you'd be the person to ask since you used to have pancakes here all the time.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Also, I feel like asking a pancake connoisseur such as yourself was my best option!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line:
Hey, did you hear that?
Shinonome likes having pancakes...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't know that...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Oh, that might've been too loud...
A lot of new customers have been coming around this time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You wouldn't stand out so much if I were able to help you eat them. And I would be able to lend Mita a hand...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why are you feeling so bad about this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In that case, let us taste-test with him!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That should help take some attention off Akito like Toya said, right? Are you with us, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're just after some pancakes, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, we're throwing you a lifesaver here.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I don't mind making more since we've got plenty of ingredients. And I do wanna hear from more people!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Just gimme a second to go whip them up!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Check it out!
These are the new Strawberries Galore Pancakes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, so many strawberries! This looks delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These pancakes... They have a pink hue to them...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Oh, thanks for noticing!
The batter has strawberries in it! Hence, “strawberries galore”!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wow... It sounds like you put a lot of effort into these.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I did! I don't wanna serve any half-baked dishes here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The toppings are so elaborate too!
Okay, let's start digging in!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mmm! This strawberry sauce is so good!
The fruity tartness goes amazingly well with the sweetness of the pancakes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, this whipped cream also complements it really well!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I appreciate both your compliments!
After all, I did use fresh strawberries for these.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, lemme try a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What do you think...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, they aren't bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But they're a far cry from Ken's pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Grr! I had a feeling...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I think these are really yummy...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Still, Akito's a regular here, so I'm inclined to believe what he's saying.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: As bittersweet as this is, I'll just have to make something next time that you'll have no choice but to praise! So get ready!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, good luck with that.
But I'll be happy to taste-test again if you need me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hold on a second! That just means you want more pancakes, doesn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not true. Don't put me in the same category as you guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A lot has changed since RAD BLAST happened...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So it is nice to be able to have pancakes here again.)
